realism_suffix: Unretouched editorial photography: natural skin texture with visible pores, fine lines, sun spots and vellus hair, honest imperfections, subtle facial asymmetry, absolutely no beauty retouching or digital smoothing. Shot on a full-frame camera, 85mm lens at f/2, subtle film grain. The image contains no text, no lettering, no logos other than those on the referenced product, and no graphic overlays.

items.prompt: Environmental portrait of a woman in her late sixties standing on a coastal hiking trail, shoulder-length silver hair moving slightly in the wind, deep laugh lines around her eyes and mouth, sun-weathered freckled skin, warm genuine expression looking slightly off camera. She wears a slate-blue softshell hiking jacket. Overcast coastal daylight, soft and even.

No text, no lettering, no graphic overlays beyond the product's own printed pattern.
